source: Independently authored fictional comments for a pumpkin-carving recording rehearsal. No actual viewer messages, identities, reactions or transcription from the supplied video.

events.author: Maya · simulated viewer
events.text: First time here — a pumpkin-carving hangout sounds lovely 🎃

events.author: Theo · simulated viewer
events.text: What do you look for when choosing a pumpkin to carve?

events.author: Jules · simulated viewer
events.text: Are you following a pattern or figuring out the design as you go?

events.text: What tool would you recommend for someone carving their first pumpkin?

events.author: Rowan · simulated viewer
events.text: Do you save the seeds to roast afterward?

events.author: Casey · simulated viewer
events.text: How do you tell when you’ve scraped the inside thin enough?

events.author: Morgan · simulated viewer
events.text: I always lose track of the little pieces. Do you cut the small details first or last?

events.author: Ari · simulated viewer
events.text: What would you do differently for carving with kids?

events.author: Jamie · simulated viewer
events.text: If a thin part breaks off, is there a way to rescue it?

events.author: Lee · simulated viewer
events.text: This makes me want to try carving one this weekend.

events.author: Sam · simulated viewer
events.text: Would you light it with an LED or a candle?

events.text: Just joined — what’s the plan for the pumpkin?

development_expectations.provenance: All comments and identities are authored simulation, not evidence of the original audience.
development_expectations.timing: Comments are spread across the ten-minute test; a timestamp does not assert the host has reached that carving step.
development_expectations.welcome_and_support: Ordinary greetings and encouragement need not become presenter cues or public cards.
development_expectations.questions: Producer chooses useful questions only when they fit the actual programme; selection and answers are not scripted.
development_expectations.moderation: Deleted messages, cleared-user messages and room-cleared questions must no longer be eligible for display.
development_expectations.facts: Questions are not proof of a technique, completed result, safety condition or factual answer.
